meta.title: Arda Sentürk – iOS apps and open-source tools
meta.description: Arda Sentürk is an independent developer building private, native iOS apps like Weightly, Finly, Lunavia and Atleva, and open-source tools for developers.

hero.tagline: I build private, native iOS apps and open-source tools for developers.

projects.title: Things I've built
projects.subtitle: Apps live on the App Store, apps on their way there, and open-source tools you can read, use and change.
projects.allRepos: See all public repositories on GitHub

atleva.description: No-equipment home workouts. Pick a goal, tap your focus areas on the body map and get a plan that adapts to how you feel, with 119 exercise videos that work offline.
atleva.update: Now on the App Store, in 11 languages.

weightly.description: Weight tracker with a smart trend line that smooths out daily swings. No account, no ads, and your data stays on your devices.
weightly.update: More reliable Weightly PRO purchases and restores.

finly.description: Budget and expense log for iPhone and Apple Watch. Type “coffee 4.50” and you're done. No account, no bank login.
finly.update: Approve or delete automatically captured payments right from the notification.

lunavia.description: Private period and cycle tracker with predictions, quick logging and sourced health articles. Everything stays on your iPhone.
lunavia.update: More reliable purchases and restores, while your cycle data still stays on your iPhone.

howWell.description: A fun question-and-answer game for friends. Test how well you know each other.

kickoff.description: Football live scores, lineups, stats and alerts from thousands of competitions, free. Kickoff Pro adds AI forecasts for every match.

elemix.description: A calm element puzzle game for iPhone. Combine materials, drag the clock and set the temperature to reach the target in endless levels.

vitrin.description: Reads your app's code and makes the store metadata, screenshots and App Previews, then runs your whole App Store Connect from one Mac app. Driven by Claude Code.
vitrin.update: Metadata now follows how App Store search really works, with new keyword checks.

remoteCode.description: Drive Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI on your Mac from your iPhone or iPad. End-to-end encrypted, no server, no account.
remoteCode.update: App Review notifications: hear on your Mac and phone when an app is in review, approved or rejected.

promoStudio.description: A Mac app that turns your app's source code into short vertical videos, written and directed by Claude Code, and posts them to Instagram.
promoStudio.update: A second Gemini key keeps the voiceover going when the first runs out of quota.

promoTemplates.description: Vertical videos generated from code: physics loops, puzzles and chat stories in Remotion, plus the Claude Code skills that make new ones.
promoTemplates.update: New “Satisfying” template: what happens when the weight keeps going up?

polylocal.description: On-device AI translator for macOS. Translate and rewrite text in any app with ⌘C C, and follow meetings in another language. Nothing leaves your Mac.
polylocal.update: Speak and the translation starts by itself, plus 20 interface languages.

kadraj.description: A fast, native screenshot tool for macOS: capture, annotate, OCR and pin.

videoCompressor.description: A native macOS menu bar app that shrinks videos. Drag one in, get a smaller copy back, with presets for Discord, WhatsApp and e-mail.

a11y.description: Self-hosted accessibility crawler for Expo and React Native apps. Explores screens with Appium, audits them against WCAG 2.2 and reports in a local dashboard.

pinGenerator.description: A small TypeScript tool that turns SVG icons into map pin PNGs in any size and writes the marker list to mapSettings.json.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I have been involved in software development for about 15 years and have several apps live on the App Store. I have been working as a React-Native Developer at a company for over 3 years, gaining experience through many different projects.
about.p2: Throughout my career I have taken part in many projects and given various training sessions, working with React-Native, NestJS, Node.js, Unity and Swift. Recently I rebuilt my own apps natively in SwiftUI, with Apple Watch apps, widgets, Apple Health and Siri support.
about.p3: I also build open-source tools for Mac and for AI coding agents like Claude Code, from automating App Store listings to promo videos and on-device translation. Learning new technologies is what keeps me going.

contact.title: Let's build something
contact.subtitle: I'm always interested in new opportunities and collaborations. Write to me.
